title: Lights! Camera! English!
paragraphs: We all hear about foreign actors making it big in Hollywood. But many acknowledge that they were shaking in their boots the first time they were waiting for the director to shout: 'Action!'

Spanish actress Penelope Cruz, star of Zoolander 2 and Vanilla Sky, is a respected actress with a Hollywood career. But she hardly spoke any English when she was cast in her first role in an English language movie in 1998. In a candid interview with the US broadcaster CBS, Penelope admitted: "I would lock myself in the bathroom and cry because I didn't understand what was going on on the set, because I didn't understand everything that the director was saying or what the other actors were saying."

Closer to home we have the example of Ziyi Zhang. She gained international acclaim in Memoirs of a Geisha and Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon and received many nominations for awards. What's helped her to learn English? Well, she says she listened to Eminem songs. And as she learned the language, she realised "how rude" the lyrics were.

But when it comes to acting in English, nobody has a more colourful story than Austrian Arnold Schwarzenegger. He had to be dubbed at the beginning of his career because nobody could make out what he was saying. In his next film, he played a deaf mute.

Yes - the complicated name, the thick accent, the big body - nothing stopped him from doing the things he liked. So don't despair when you struggle with English. They've all been there and they've prevailed. Are you ready for your close up in life?

vocabulary.entry: make it big [phr.] /meɪk ɪt bɪɡ/ 大获成功 (口语)
vocabulary.example: He dreamed of making it big in the music industry.
vocabulary.translation: 他梦想在音乐界大获成功。

vocabulary.entry: shake in one's boots [phr.] /ʃeɪk ɪn wʌnz buːts/ 紧张得发抖 (口语；固定搭配)
vocabulary.example: The young actor was shaking in his boots before his first audition.
vocabulary.translation: 这位年轻演员在第一次试镜前紧张得发抖。

vocabulary.entry: action [n.] /ˈækʃən/ 开拍 (专业词汇；电影术语)
vocabulary.example: The director shouted 'Action!' and the scene began.
vocabulary.translation: 导演喊“开拍！”，场景开始了。

vocabulary.entry: candid [adj.] /ˈkændɪd/ 坦诚的；率直的 (书面语)
vocabulary.example: She gave a candid interview about her struggles with fame.
vocabulary.translation: 她坦诚地接受了一次关于她成名之路的挣扎的采访。

vocabulary.entry: set [n.] /set/ 片场；摄影棚 (专业词汇)
vocabulary.example: All the actors were required to be on set by 6 a.m.
vocabulary.translation: 所有演员被要求在早上6点前到达片场。

vocabulary.entry: international acclaim [n.] /ˌɪntəˈnæʃənəl əˈkleɪm/ 国际赞誉 (书面语)
vocabulary.example: The novel received international acclaim and won several prizes.
vocabulary.translation: 这部小说获得了国际赞誉并赢得了多个奖项。

vocabulary.entry: nomination [n.] /ˌnɒmɪˈneɪʃən/ 提名
vocabulary.example: The film received five Academy Award nominations.
vocabulary.translation: 这部电影获得了五项奥斯卡金像奖提名。

vocabulary.entry: lyrics [n. pl.] /ˈlɪrɪks/ 歌词 (单数: lyric)
vocabulary.example: The song's lyrics are about love and loss.
vocabulary.translation: 这首歌的歌词是关于爱与失去。

vocabulary.entry: dub [v.] /dʌb/ 配音 (专业词汇)
vocabulary.example: Foreign films are often dubbed into English for international audiences.
vocabulary.translation: 外国电影通常被配音成英语供国际观众观看。

vocabulary.entry: make out [phr.] /meɪk aʊt/ 理解；听清 (口语；固定搭配)
vocabulary.example: I could just make out what she was saying above the noise.
vocabulary.translation: 在嘈杂声中我勉强能听清她说的话。

vocabulary.entry: deaf mute [n.] /def mjuːt/ 聋哑人 (旧式用语；专业词汇)
vocabulary.example: He learned sign language to communicate with his deaf mute brother.
vocabulary.translation: 他学习手语以便与聋哑弟弟交流。

vocabulary.entry: complicated [adj.] /ˈkɒmplɪkeɪtɪd/ 复杂的
vocabulary.example: The instructions were so complicated that nobody could follow them.
vocabulary.translation: 说明书太复杂了，没人能看懂。

vocabulary.entry: accent [n.] /ˈæksənt/ 口音
vocabulary.example: She speaks English with a slight French accent.
vocabulary.translation: 她说英语带有一点法国口音。

vocabulary.entry: despair [v.] /dɪˈspeə/ 绝望 (书面语)
vocabulary.example: Don't despair if you don't succeed the first time.
vocabulary.translation: 如果第一次没成功也不要绝望。

vocabulary.entry: prevail [v.] /prɪˈveɪl/ 成功；战胜 (书面语)
vocabulary.example: Justice will prevail in the end.
vocabulary.translation: 正义终将获胜。

vocabulary.entry: close up [n.] /kləʊs ʌp/ 特写镜头 (专业词汇)
vocabulary.example: The camera zoomed in for a close up of the actor's face.
vocabulary.translation: 摄像机拉近给演员的脸一个特写镜头。

vocabulary.entry: cast [v.] /kɑːst/ 选角；选派角色 (专业词汇；过去分词 cast)
vocabulary.example: She was cast as the lead in the new movie.
vocabulary.translation: 她被选为新电影的主角。

vocabulary.entry: acknowledge [v.] /əkˈnɒlɪdʒ/ 承认 (书面语)
vocabulary.example: He reluctantly acknowledged that he had made a mistake.
vocabulary.translation: 他不情愿地承认自己犯了错误。

vocabulary.entry: respected [adj.] /rɪˈspektɪd/ 受尊敬的
vocabulary.example: She is a highly respected professor in her field.
vocabulary.translation: 她是自己领域内一位备受尊敬的教授。

vocabulary.entry: colourful [adj.] /ˈkʌlərfəl/ 丰富多彩的；有趣的 (英式拼写，美式: colorful)
vocabulary.example: He has led a very colourful life, full of adventures.
vocabulary.translation: 他过着非常丰富多彩的生活，充满了冒险。

sentences.english: We all hear about foreign actors making it big in Hollywood.
sentences.chinese: 我们都听说过外国演员在好莱坞大获成功的故事。

sentences.english: But many acknowledge that they were shaking in their boots the first time they were waiting for the director to shout: 'Action!'
sentences.chinese: 但许多人承认，当他们第一次等待导演喊“开拍”时，他们紧张得发抖。

sentences.english: Spanish actress Penelope Cruz, star of Zoolander 2 and Vanilla Sky, is a respected actress with a Hollywood career.
sentences.chinese: 西班牙女演员佩内洛普·克鲁兹是《超级名模2》和《香草天空》中的明星，是一位备受尊敬的拥有好莱坞职业生涯的女演员。

sentences.english: But she hardly spoke any English when she was cast in her first role in an English language movie in 1998.
sentences.chinese: 但她在1998年首次出演英语电影时几乎不会说英语。

sentences.english: In a candid interview with the US broadcaster CBS, Penelope admitted: "I would lock myself in the bathroom and cry because I didn't understand what was going on on the set, because I didn't understand everything that the director was saying or what the other actors were saying."
sentences.chinese: 在一次接受美国广播公司CBS的采访时，佩内洛普坦承：“我会把自己锁在浴室里哭，因为我不明白片场发生了什么，因为我不明白导演在说什么，也不明白其他演员在说什么。”

sentences.english: Closer to home we have the example of Ziyi Zhang.
sentences.chinese: 我们更熟悉的例子是章子怡。

sentences.english: She gained international acclaim in Memoirs of a Geisha and Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon and received many nominations for awards.
sentences.chinese: 她因《艺伎回忆录》和《卧虎藏龙》获得国际赞誉，并多次获得奖项提名。

sentences.english: What's helped her to learn English?
sentences.chinese: 是什么帮助她学习英语的呢？

sentences.english: Well, she says she listened to Eminem songs.
sentences.chinese: 她说她听埃米纳姆的歌。

sentences.english: And as she learned the language, she realised "how rude" the lyrics were.
sentences.chinese: 当她掌握了这门语言，她才意识到歌词是“多么粗俗”。

sentences.english: But when it comes to acting in English, nobody has a more colourful story than Austrian Arnold Schwarzenegger.
sentences.chinese: 但一谈到用英语表演，没有人比奥地利人阿诺德·施瓦辛格的故事更丰富多彩了。

sentences.english: He had to be dubbed at the beginning of his career because nobody could make out what he was saying.
sentences.chinese: 在他职业生涯的初期，他不得不被配音，因为没有人能理解他在说什么。

sentences.english: In his next film, he played a deaf mute.
sentences.chinese: 在他的下一部电影中，他扮演了一个聋哑人。

sentences.english: Yes - the complicated name, the thick accent, the big body - nothing stopped him from doing the things he liked.
sentences.chinese: 是的——复杂的名字、浓重的口音、庞大的身躯——没有什么能阻止他做自己喜欢的事情。

sentences.english: So don't despair when you struggle with English.
sentences.chinese: 所以，当你在英语学习中遇到挫折时，不要绝望。

sentences.english: They've all been there and they've prevailed.
sentences.chinese: 他们都经历过，并且成功了。

sentences.english: Are you ready for your close up in life?
sentences.chinese: 你准备好迎接你生命中的特写镜头了吗？
